source_files.claim: The existing system in-process macro saves original IPC identity, resets to this native process, calls, then restores it. No new reset macro or bypass is added.

TOKEN_NATIVE is SA; caller access is granted only through existing native SA support or real same-app/invisible/background permission rules. An ordinary unprivileged direct launch does not inherit AMS native identity.
Caller data is rebuilt from actual native AbilityRecord, then existing committed dialogSession delegates native caller identity. No remote token from a JS Want establishes authority.
Cancel sends the original native requestCode to actual caller scheduler; selection launch success is not a target result.
